name: p2-first-serve-mute
criterion: At recorded source callback 40, all three mapped native tone volumes must be zero, matching the source all-muted state. This verifies the hardware mute action; filter decay and later sound remain separate waveform criteria. Emitted audio must also be nonzero in the original-established pre-mute window and zero at PCM16 precision in the post-mute window, with channels checked individually.
contract: First-serve mute hardware action and bounded emitted signal/silence; independent of pitch/envelope failures. Onset and filter decay deadlines remain separate.

test_requirements.missing_behaviour: Emitted sound must be present before the first-serve mute and silent afterwards; register checks alone do not establish output.
test_requirements.plausible_regression: An unmuted output channel or missing/corrupted waveform can leave audible residue or remove the effect despite the expected logical commands.
test_requirements.independent_expectation: Hash-validated original PCM16 WAV and exact PSG callback40 association establish the audible and silent windows.
test_requirements.stopping_condition: Both bounded windows match the original at PCM16 precision and real private mute-volume and zero-waveform faults are rejected; stop equivalent mute windows.
